A blue oval annotation is overlaid on a central region of the image, highlighting a specific area of interest — potentially indicating a vascular lesion, stenosis, aneurysm, occlusion, or other pathological finding. The surrounding anatomy shows multiple vessel branches. No scale bar, patient data, quantitative measurements, or figure legend are visible. The imaging modality and anatomical region cannot be confirmed without additional context.
